item.title: Can you lose your Swedish citizenship if you've never lived in Sweden?
item.description: Children of Swedish citizens can be eligible for citizenship by descent, but it's important to know the rules for hanging on to your Swedish citizenship if you've never lived in the country.

item.title: How to buy your own Swedish island
item.description: Ever felt like spending your summers lounging around on your own island? Or have you always wanted to build a James Bond-style supervillain fort in the middle of the Stockholm archipelago?

item.title: Today in Sweden: A roundup of the latest news on Monday
item.description: Orange weather warning in Skåne, man run over by underground train miraculously survives, more soldiers in the Home Guard and other news from Sweden on Monday.

item.title: TELL US: Are you affected by the coming layoffs at Ericsson in Sweden?
item.description: The Swedish tech giant Ericsson this month announced it wanted to lay off 1,200 workers in Sweden, about one in every ten. We want to hear from readers who are affected about what they think of the redundancy programme.

item.title: OPINION: 'Is this really the country you want to build, Sweden?'
item.description: Fereshteh Javani, founder of 'We are 4,700 workers', the campaign for those affected by the government's abolition of the track-change law, calls for the government to think about whether it really wants Sweden to be a country that deports law-abiding workers.

item.title: Swedish bosses now earn 77 times more than an average worker
item.description: Normal workers have seen their purchasing power drop as salaries have failed to rise in line with inflation, but the same cannot be said of their bosses. The wage gap has hit a new record, according to the Swedish Trade Union Confederation.

item.title: What are the new words in Sweden's language rulebook?
item.description: Könsdysfori, sträcktitta and hantverksöl are in, but uä-barn and åldersskröplig are out. Here are some words joining or leaving the official list of contemporary Swedish.

item.title: How to handle a salary review in Sweden
item.description: Yearly salary negotiations take place in the spring for many workers as collective bargaining agreements are renegotiated. How do salary reviews work and how can you prepare?

item.title: Sweden pushes forward with controversial plan to jail 13-year-olds
item.description: Sweden's government is pushing ahead with a controversial plan to jail 13-year-olds found guilty of murder, attempted murder, aggravated rape and aggravated public destruction for up to two years.

item.title: Swedish word of the day: måndag
item.description: It's the start of a new week, so here's a timely Swedish word of the day.
